definition.text_en: to you; for you, preposition ל with second person singular suffix (feminine, or masculine in pause).
definition.text_es: a ti; para ti, preposición ל con sufijo de segunda persona singular (femenino, o masculino en pausa).

reason: the exact-form entry also covers the masculine pausal form, as in Luke 4:7 and John 8:48, so the gloss names both
